Title: LSJ- Loki's Gift + Restricted Vitae + Hospital Food

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Does Loki's Gift combine with Restricted Vitae and Hospital Food to
allow you to steal 2 blood off another vampire if you are an anarch?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
XZealot wrote:
> Does Loki's Gift combine with Restricted Vitae and Hospital Food to
> allow you to steal 2 blood off another vampire if you are an anarch?

Well, you can't combine RV's action with Loki's Gift's action.

Loki's Gift allows the action printed on the card.
Restricted Vitae offers a different action.

But Hospital Food may be used on either of those.

LG + HF = Gain 2 blood and this card and, if superior, burn 1 blood from another
vampire.

RV + HF = Steal 2 blood from a younger vampire.
